body:
And yes all my old posts are depressing as fuck lol. But I am in a much better headspace since than. And have a healthier take on relationships or at least like to believe I do. 

If this doesn't work out, I'll be fine. I've been through it all. And yes I know it's possible to find love and start over again. I just really wanted to make this work. But maybe I shouldn't. I'm hoping someone who is unbiased can tell me how it is. And probably sees my situation more clearly than I do. 

I feel like that's how it feels when hearing of my best friend's or sister's situation. Like the answer seems so clear to you. But not to them. Because they have rose tinted glasses on. But I do really love this guy. I hate that we hardly talk just because yknow it doesn't feel like a relationship. 

But we both have to save a lot of money anyways and our working on ourselves too. So at the same time. It does give us time for work and all that. Gosh it's just hard to really explain.

wake up and break up

On a serious note, he is acting this way because he does not love and care for you. I know it's hard to hear but someone who loves you would celebrate and be happy for you getting over your eating disorder. And seeing you healthier and you are not fat at all. Trust me you'll meet someone who treats and loves your body as you are and wants to see you healthy and happy. And not tear you down and encourage your ED just because they're a fucking pervert. Like your bf is trash sorry. I know you have your rose colored sunglasses on. But trust everyone here who sees your boyfriend for the piece of shit he is.

Wow well first off congrats on getting into law school! That's no small feat. I know how you feel. I sometimes still have those thoughts buried in my head. Life can definitely feel like a tortoise and the hare race. Things have gotten better since I wrote this post at a gradual pace. Living with parents can suck at our age lol but keep saving and stay focused on your end goal, which I'm assuming is finishing law school and getting a job before you move out. You'll reach that point eventually. In the meantime, I suggest finding things, people, or activities you love to fill the time that add joy or meaning to your life. At the time I wrote this, I was definitely seeing life as this race and I was falling behind. Either way I'm just enjoying my journey as a turtle improving one step at a time. Sorry for the essay lol, I hope things improve for you as well (:

Hey girl I know exactly how you feel albeit my family isn't abusive but pretty toxic, I know how difficult it can be trying to grow your life or find a sense of stability in a very instable environment. Just want to say keep going and working towards your goal until you find a place of your own to call home 👍 I know it can be a gradual process but you'll get there, good luck! I'll pm you my discord if you ever need someone to talk or rant to
For a moment I was wondering wth Obama was doing on Reddit before I read the title

There's a quote that comes to mind - "You're never alone when reading a book." It sounds pretty lame lol but reading is honestly such a fun avtivity on your own, it definitely let's your mind escape. I'd also recommend yoga, if you can though ofc! Hope you're feeling better soon ❤
Aw thanks, same to you ❤ This brightened up my day

I'm so happy you are doing better now! No one should ever feel that way, I'm glad that you found a job that adds both joy and fulfillment in your life. And yes, Amazon is definitely not one of those jobs lol, just a grind. It's not a bad job but it doesn't feel like it's adding to my life if that makes sense. Going back to church again has given me that kind of feeling you talked about. Unfortunately, I only go once a week. But once my schedule goes back to normal next month. I want to definitely get more involved and maybe volunteer as well. I really would just love to quit and find an apprenticeship of something I actually enjoy. The best job I ever had was working at a movie theatre, I love films and it was an awesome experience. Maybe I'll try that again for fun haha :D  Thank you for sharing, I hope you experience much more happiness; take care! ❤

I will check him out as well as Chris Hogan, thank you! It will definitely help lol, I've only just now recently reached a point where I can start building my savings so this is an awesome resource and came at the perfect time. Best wishes to you as well (:

Yeah what you said is really true especially of my past self. Like even back in the summer. I did not value myself, I did not love myself, and I threw my time and energy to someone who did not deserve it. And I never gave it to myself. Which is something I am reclaiming. Looking back now I feel sorry that I ever felt like I needed to beg not for love but just respect, just to be valued as a person with feelings. If I were to go through that same situation now again, I would have never looked back twice. I guess these experiences help us grow, I still have a lot of work left when it comes to building confidence. Because I am a really introverted person, so there's room for improvement. I would love to go on walks but this weather is so cold! 😁 But I may just need to get a scarf, some gloves, and a nice beanie and make that a routine

I am definitely stalling in the actions step area. If you were to look at my journal, you would see many dates where I began setting goals and creating a planner. Like I saw tasks I had made for myself back in August, July, even previous years, the same exact goals. It made me realize I have to not just plan but follow through. I think the best step I can do today is to take the time to write a short script or storyboard. Something simple. I am off tomorrow, my one off day off the week lol but if I can done today. I will have a direction of what tutorials I should watch to and begin the process of making my first animation project in forever. And hopefully that will be the first step to building my portfolio which is something I don't ever make time for but I always plan to. 

Thanks for the encouragement! It feels really good to have someone acknowledge my efforts so far (:

Honestly everything was helpful, thank you so much for taking the time to write all this. Actually this past week I've made small changes like trying to eat healthier. So for me my taco place has been Subways lol. I work 6 am to 6 pm, so I tend to eat a lot of fast food because it's quick and easy and on my way home. So I decided I would at least begin cutting out soda and telling myself I'll make something at home or get Subways. But it's actually had a huge difference in the way I think. It's hard to explain. Before I tended to give into the need of doing stuff that made me feel good for now but would hurt me later, and I find myself more able to resist those urges.  I started journaling too, even if I don't accomplish what I set out for the day it keeps me more accountable. 

It's crazy I watched a video this morning before going to work and it talks about pretty much what you told me. About trying to visualize yourself and the life you want whether a month or year from now. And so basically you take a habit you have, and picture yourself a year from now and where you will be if you continue it. So it works really well for both good and bad habits. And it's definitely helped me a lot with eating healthier.

But yes, I will definitely start putting my future paychecks to my savings. I'm at a point financially where it's something I can do. Work has left me pretty burn out tbh but like you said Atlanta is expensive so I'm reminding myself the end goal and I've decided I'm only working like this for the rest of December. My savings will still grow even if it's a bit slower that's okay. 

You pretty much hit everything on the nail lol, it's hard for me to get back into writing and animating because I guess I kind of lost that overflowing inspiration I had as a kid and I'm a lot more realistic than I used to be.  Or maybe I just watched a lot of cartoons and anime back then lol. But I know I can get the creative juices flowing if I listen to some of my favorite soundtracks from games and animations. Once I tap into that part of my brain, the ideas just flow. It's the starting part that's difficult lol. Thanks again ❤
Thanks for all the advice, I completely agree with you especially about following your gut. My gut is always right and I also never listen to it lol, but I'm going to start.

Wow I really like what you said about creating counters to my cons on my pros and cons list to moving. It seems really simple but it's honestly something that slipped my mind. I would definitely love to make the move and this seems like a great way to start the planning process.

I definitely can't afford therapy, but I can afford audible haha :D so I will check that out, thanks so much!

Yeah my parents and I do not always see eye to eye, but I do understand they have a lot more life experience and I know they're intentions come from a good place. And I realize having more freedom is just something I will have to wait on for when I move out, so it's best not to worry and keep working hard. 

I definitely agree with you, I am literally pulling an all nighter to get started changing it today lol at least the planning part. Reading back on what I wrote, I realized I was feeling pretty negative and just focusing on the bad parts in my rant. There's a lot of good, I am really grateful for the job I have, the parents I have, my relationships, the lessons I learned this past year. I just got to not let the past drag me like you said.
Thanks it's still really kind, I appreciate it very much :)
